outcome: Single-security, single-source observed daily dates can be queried over an inclusive window of at most 366 calendar days, refreshed and reset without retaining stale pagination.

verification.tdd: Before implementation, the new window/form suites failed on missing modules and the zero-date regression failed because identity/window/count were absent. The version test failed against 1.0.6 before the identity update.

targetedTests.scope: Web history validator/form, days parser/panel/hook and coverage caller

verification.staticChecks: Web typecheck, related ESLint, Prettier and diff checks passed. No local aggregate repository suite was run.
verification.build: One shared Node Docker build of server and web passed, including TypeScript and Vite. Later documentation changes leave application source, dependencies and runtime configuration unchanged; the verified application build is reused.

browser.environment: Authenticated actual local application and existing storage; no fixture API or credential changes.
passed: 600519.SH / akshare-tencent: Sep 1-4 inclusive returned the four observed dates.
A 367-day window and reversed dates showed accessible field errors while preserving the prior applied result and query time.
The maximum 366-day window, Oct 23 2025 to Oct 23 2026, returned 242 observed dates on five pages.
A future single-day window returned zero observations with identity, window and independent query time, without claiming a gap or completeness.
Keyboard activation of the query button worked; while loading it was natively disabled, aria-busy=true and cursor=progress.
Reset restored the original 90-day summary window with 58 observed dates. Same-window refresh from page 2 returned to page 1 and advanced the independent query time.
At a 390px override, client/scroll width both measured 375px; the inner table scrolled at 257px/900px. Both label gaps measured 8px. The viewport override was reset.
browser.dateInputMethod: Native keyboard events were used after automation fill changed displayed dates without dispatching the React change event. Actual native input submitted the selected dates correctly.
browser.screenshot: Actual accepted page retained in ignored local work; only an existing public sample and generic local administrator label are visible.

verification.review: Primary-agent bounded final diff review completed; no changes to public contracts, persistence, permissions, collection or trading paths. This medium-risk read-only UI slice did not require a separate independent review.

localRuntime.containers: Web and server healthy. Only those application containers were recreated; existing database and worker containers were preserved.

knownLimits: Observed dates do not establish expected trading days, missing-day status or completeness; missing-day judgment remains unknown.
Detail query time is independent of the summary. The history window only filters the selected security/source detail, not the summary or published evidence.
This accepts a P1-N12 UI slice, not the complete node or Phase 1. No production deployment or trading capability is claimed.
